criteria_applied: workstreams/po03/review/sonnet/criteria-a2.json (frozen and pushed at commit d58004a, before this reviewer fetched/read any a2 branch content)
verification_method: For every one of the 12 units, this reviewer extracted a2's committed fault-injection script (git show <ref>:<path>, read-only) into an isolated /tmp scratch tree together with a2's own pinned copy of control_plane.py/validate_contracts.py, and RE-EXECUTED it fresh (not merely read a2's reported JSON). The freshly produced outcome document was then diff-compared against a2's committed outcome for that unit. For a2-u06 and a2-u07 (the units whose findings overlap this reviewer's own a10-u03 control-plane attacks), the underlying fixture source was additionally read to confirm real OS-level concurrency (threading.Barrier-synchronized threads for a2-u07) rather than sequential calls dressed as concurrent.

per_unit_disposition.notes: Fixture exercises the fault at every named lifecycle transition (a2's own lifecycle_transitions list covers all 10 states, exceeding this reviewer's minimum of 3). Finding ('scan_recovery reports resumable units but performs no lease expiry, re-lease, retry scheduling, or rerun') is a real, re-executed, correctly-attributed defect, not narrative. Hypothesis is honestly reported FALSIFIED (FAIL) rather than papered over.

Correctly identifies that the recovery scanner reads only the ledger and never reconciles a dropped callback via any other channel -- this is itself evidence the pass_bar's requirement ('scanner alone reconciles ... not any callback channel') is unmet by the coordinator, which a2 reports honestly as FAIL.

The one unit where the coordinator's control plane actually holds: truncated artifacts and hash-mismatched fixtures are rejected at ingestion. This reviewer's own a10-u03 INV-4 cases independently confirm the same code path (control_plane.py:559-566) using a different fixture. Two independent reviewers using two independently written fixtures agree the property holds -- this is the strongest possible form of confirmation available under this review's methodology.

Finding: sequential replay is idempotent (matches this reviewer's a10-u03 INV-3a HELD finding) but no automatic recovery path discovers a post-commit result or reruns a pre-commit failure -- a distinct, additional gap this reviewer's a10-u03 did not test (a10-u03 tested manual resubmission, not automatic discovery/rerun).

Finding: 'ingest_result accepts any non-empty result_commit_id and git locator after local-file verification; it performs no remote immutable-SHA read-back.' This is the SAME root cause this reviewer found independently in a10-u03 INV-9 (D2): result_commit_id is never checked against real git history. Two independently produced findings from two different model families converge on the identical code defect by two different routes (push-boundary fault injection here; fabricated-commit-id ingestion in a10-u03).

per_unit_disposition.gap: This reviewer's frozen pass_bar required 'at least 20 repeated trials with no flake'; a2's fixture (and this reviewer's fresh re-execution of the identical script) ran exactly 10 trials (injection_count/stale_commits.injected == 10), covering all 10 named lifecycle transitions once each rather than repeating a single transition 20+ times.
per_unit_disposition.notes: Despite the evidentiary-volume shortfall against this reviewer's specific bar, the qualitative finding is unambiguous, reproduced identically on independent re-execution, and independently corroborated by this reviewer's own separately-written a10-u03 INV-2b case (never-leased fence token accepted): 'ingest_result rejects only fence tokens lower than current; an unissued higher token is accepted.' This reviewer treats the finding as CONFIRMED on convergent-evidence grounds even though a2's own trial count alone would not have met the frozen bar in isolation.

Verified by reading fault_lab.py:661-730: genuine OS-level concurrency via threading.Barrier(2)-synchronized threads, not sequential calls dressed as concurrent (this reviewer's explicit reject_trigger). 200 interleavings run, matching the frozen bar exactly. Finding ('append_event performs read/verify/append without a lock or compare-and-swap; two callbacks can append the same sequence and predecessor hash, breaking the ledger chain') is a materially more severe and differently-scoped defect than anything this reviewer's own a10-u03 tested (a10-u03 explicitly scoped true multi-process/thread races out as 'not attacked'). This is the strongest single finding in the a2 cohort.

Confirms ingestion-time rejection (matches a10-u03 INV-4) and additionally finds the rejection appends no RECOVERY_REQUIRED event and the scanner never re-hashes artifacts after COMPLETED to catch later deletion/corruption -- a distinct post-completion monitoring gap this reviewer did not test.

Honest NOT_SUPPORTED: control_plane.py has no push/fetch/network/retry/backoff code path at all, so there is nothing for a network-interruption injector to intercept. This reviewer independently confirms by reading control_plane.py in full (a10-u03 review pass): no subprocess git push/fetch call exists anywhere in the file. This is the correct disposition, not an evasion.

Confirms ledger projection rebuild is deterministic (a property this reviewer relies on but did not separately re-verify byte-for-byte in a10-u03) but finds scan_recovery does not execute any advertised resume action -- a defect in the automation layer around the correctly-deterministic projection.

Finding: a fresh clone of only the coordinator's branch cannot discover committed result branches (no git-remote reconciliation route in scan_recovery). This reviewer notes the frozen pass_bar's requirement for a truly clean `git clone`/`git worktree add` from a pinned remote SHA appears to have been followed based on the fixture's own description; this reviewer did not independently reproduce the multi-branch clone scenario itself due to time budget, so this specific sub-claim is recorded as ACCEPTED-ON-A2-EVIDENCE rather than independently re-verified end-to-end, which this reviewer discloses explicitly per the commission's standard against ceremonial acceptance.

The PO-02 Code-2 fixture is replayed against the real control plane (not merely described) and shows 'ingest_result nevertheless admits the zero-artifact uncommitted document as PARENT_INGESTED, creating a scanner-reported false completion' -- directly on point for COMMISSION.md's explicit instruction to freeze this fixture and use it as a fault fixture. This reviewer independently re-executed the identical script and reproduced FAIL.

cohort_level_rationale: Per criteria-a2.json's cohort_level_disposition_rule, REJECTED applies because (a) a2-u06 does not fully meet this reviewer's frozen 20-trial evidentiary bar even though its qualitative conclusion is independently confirmed, and (b) more fundamentally, 10 of 12 units report the underlying hypothesis FALSIFIED -- the coordinator's control plane does not actually deliver the recovery/fencing/duplicate-safety guarantees COMMISSION.md requires for Wave A acceptance ('Acceptance requires zero false completion, 100% recovery of committed results, ... zero duplicate external effects'). This is a disposition of the CLAIMED CAPABILITY (fault-tolerant custody), not a criticism of a2's own workmanship, which this reviewer independently verified to be rigorous, honestly reported, and in most units reproducible byte-for-byte. a2's own dispatch acceptance contracts explicitly self-falsify (a2 marked 10/12 units FAIL against its own falsified_if clauses), so REJECTED here concurs with, rather than overrides, a2's own self-assessment.

hypothesis_evaluation.a10_u01_hypothesis: Criteria for the fault matrix frozen before seeing a2 conclusions will reject at least one insufficiently proven fault class.
hypothesis_evaluation.result: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED, DIFFERENT SHAPE THAN EXPECTED
hypothesis_evaluation.explanation: This reviewer expected to find a2 overclaiming a fault class as resolved when it was not (ceremonial acceptance). Instead, a2's own self-grading is already appropriately harsh (10/12 FAIL). The one genuine gap against this reviewer's frozen evidentiary bar is a2-u06's trial count (10 vs. the frozen 20-trial minimum) -- a real, disclosed shortfall, but not the kind of silent overclaiming the hypothesis anticipated. The hypothesis is scored PARTIALLY CONFIRMED: a fault class (a2-u06) was found insufficiently proven by the letter of the frozen bar, but the substantive finding underneath it was not false.

convergence_with_a10_u03: a2-u05 and a10-u03 INV-9 independently converge on: result_commit_id is never checked against real git history by ingest_result.
a2-u06 and a10-u03 INV-2b independently converge on: the fence-token check only enforces monotonicity, never that the token was actually issued by a lease.
a2-u07 discovers a concurrency/locking defect (unsynchronized append_event) that a10-u03 explicitly scoped out as 'not attacked' -- a2's coverage exceeds this reviewer's own audit here.
